params.body:
The pipeline side of the Observatory's **Accounts** page (gentells-site #accounts-api, gentells-dashboard follows).

- `GET /site/accounts` and `POST /site/accounts/:id`, admins only. They relay to the site's `/internal/accounts` routes, on the origin of `GENTELLS_WEBHOOK_URL`, signed with `GENTELLS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`. Both are already set on the box.
- **Signature:** HMAC-SHA256 over METHOD, path, timestamp and body (empty for a GET), which is what the site verifies.
- **Allowed fields:** only `plan`, `trial_days`, `disabled` and `note` pass. The admin's address is added as `by`, so the site's log says who.

Tests: `test/site-accounts.test.mjs` (the signature matches the site's check, non-admins get 403). 965 passing.
params.title: Accounts: an admin-only relay to the site's account routes
